headline: Sensex Ends Above 81,000 and Nifty Reclaims 25,000 Following Strong Recovery Driven by Bank Buying

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Buying in banking stocks supported market recovery during the session.
Easing crude oil prices provided positive momentum to equity markets.
Benchmarks staged a strong recovery after experiencing early-trade profit-taking.
Initial declines were triggered by selling in IT stocks.
whatHappening: Sensex recovered early losses to close over 100 points higher, surpassing 81,000.
Nifty reclaimed and settled above the 25,000 mark.
Shares of Data Patterns jumped 9% during the trading session.
FPI inflows into FAR G-Secs rose nearly ₹8,000 crore as yields eased and rupee gained.
summary: Indian benchmark indices staged a strong recovery from early-session lows to end in the green. Buying in banking stocks and easing crude oil prices pushed the Sensex above 81,000 and Nifty over 25,000. Data Patterns surged 9% during the day.
